import zipfile, math, statistics, re

class Node:
    __slots__=('children','name','length')
    def __init__(self,name=None,length=0.0):
        self.children=[]; self.name=name; self.length=length

def parse_newick(s):
    s=s.strip()
    i=0
    def skip():
        nonlocal i
        while i<len(s) and s[i].isspace(): i+=1
    def label():
        nonlocal i
        skip(); start=i
        while i<len(s) and s[i] not in '(),:;[]' and not s[i].isspace(): i+=1
        return s[start:i] or None
    def number():
        nonlocal i
        skip(); start=i
        while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',();[]' and not s[i].isspace(): i+=1
        return float(s[start:i]) if i>start else 0.0
    def subtree():
        nonlocal i
        skip()
        if i<len(s) and s[i]=='(':
            i+=1; n=Node()
            while True:
                n.children.append(subtree()); skip()
                if i<len(s) and s[i]==',': i+=1; continue
                if i<len(s) and s[i]==')': i+=1; break
                raise ValueError((i,s[i:i+30]))
            n.name=label(); skip()
        else:
            n=Node(name=label())
        skip()
        if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
            i+=1; n.length=number()
        skip()
        # Skip bracket comments if present.
        while i<len(s) and s[i]=='[':
            j=s.find(']',i+1)
            if j<0: raise ValueError('unclosed comment')
            i=j+1; skip()
        return n
    root=subtree(); return root

def leaves(n, parent_dist=0.0, out=None):
    if out is None: out=[]
    if not n.children: out.append((n.name,parent_dist)); return out
    for c in n.children: leaves(c,parent_dist+c.length,out)
    return out

def mean_pairwise(root):
    # Recursively derive distance between every pair across child subtrees.
    vals=[]
    def rec(n):
        if not n.children: return [(n.name,0.0)]
        groups=[]
        for c in n.children:
            groups.append([(name,d+c.length) for name,d in rec(c)])
        all_leaves=[]
        for g in groups:
            for x in g:
                for y in all_leaves:
                    vals.append(x[1]+y[1])
                all_leaves.append(x)
        out=[]
        for g in groups: out.extend(g)
        return out
    rec(root)
    return statistics.fmean(vals), vals

def get(group):
    zname=f'inputs/scogs_{group}.zip'
    rows=[]
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zname) as z:
        for name in z.namelist():
            if not name.endswith('.treefile'): continue
            root=parse_newick(z.read(name).decode())
            m,p=mean_pairwise(root)
            tips=[x[0] for x in leaves(root)]
            rows.append((name.split('.')[0],m,len(tips),tuple(sorted(tips)),p,z.read(name).decode().strip()))
    return rows
for group in ['animals','fungi']:
    rows=get(group)
    print('\\n',group,'n',len(rows))
    print('tip counts', {k:sum(r[2]==k for r in rows) for k in sorted({r[2] for r in rows})})
    print('tip sets', {k:sum(r[3]==k for r in rows) for k in sorted({r[3] for r in rows})})
    ms=[r[1] for r in rows]
    print('mean range', min(ms),max(ms),'median',statistics.median(ms),'mean',statistics.fmean(ms))
    print('first sorted means', sorted(ms)[:5], sorted(ms)[-5:])
    print('taxon counts', {t:sum(t in r[3] for r in rows) for t in sorted(set(x for r in rows for x in r[3]))})

A=get('animals'); F=get('fungi')
print('\\nRATIO all F/A',statistics.median([r[1] for r in F])/statistics.median([r[1] for r in A]))
# complete 4 only
for label, pred in [('complete4',lambda r:r[2]==4),('3only',lambda r:r[2]==3)]:
    aa=[r[1] for r in A if pred(r)]; ff=[r[1] for r in F if pred(r)]
    print(label,'n',len(aa),len(ff),'medians',statistics.median(aa) if aa else None,statistics.median(ff) if ff else None,'ratio',statistics.median(ff)/statistics.median(aa) if aa else None)
# all common gene IDs with both trees
ad={r[0]:r for r in A}; fd={r[0]:r for r in F}; common=sorted(set(ad)&set(fd))
print('common IDs',len(common),'A/F medians common',statistics.median([ad[k][1] for k in common]),statistics.median([fd[k][1] for k in common]),'ratio',statistics.median([fd[k][1] for k in common])/statistics.median([ad[k][1] for k in common]))
# complete in both/common 4
common4=[k for k in common if ad[k][2]==4 and fd[k][2]==4]
print('common complete IDs',len(common4),'medians',statistics.median([ad[k][1] for k in common4]) if common4 else None,statistics.median([fd[k][1] for k in common4]) if common4 else None,'ratio',statistics.median([fd[k][1] for k in common4])/statistics.median([ad[k][1] for k in common4]) if common4 else None)
PY"
